name: Oanarina Archi Tool
subtitle: Architecture, CAD and BIM
description:
Oanarina Archi Tool is a native Mac workspace for architectural drawing, 3D modeling and building information modeling. Draw with precise coordinates, snaps and familiar command aliases. Build projects with levels, walls, doors, windows, floors, roofs, stairs and rooms, then arrange sheets and export drawings or schedules.

Work in 2D and 3D, edit materials, render views, and exchange models using implemented formats including DXF, IFC, OBJ, STL and GLB. Save projects in the native .archi format. Automate work through the built-in JavaScript console and opt-in local agent API.

Core drawing and modeling work offline. Online lookups and a configured AI provider require a connection. Select project folders to access linked resources and multi-file exports in the sandboxed Mac App Store edition. Standalone command-line MCP and Python tooling are available in the website edition.
reviewNotes:
VERSION 1.0.3: Includes a separate fix that centres new sheet viewports on the content visible in their level/view. Existing viewports can be corrected with VPFIT (undo supported). The local agent server described below is implemented and requires the retained network.server entitlement.

Native macOS app for macOS 14+, Apple silicon and Intel. No login is required. Open the bundled Cedar House from the start screen. File > Allow Project Folder Access selects a folder for linked assets, backups and exports. Online AI is optional and uses the user's own provider; local CAD/BIM and the following server demonstration require no AI account. Standalone CLI/Python tools are available in the website edition.

NETWORK SERVER ENTITLEMENT: com.apple.security.network.server is required by the implemented opt-in local agent server in this submitted build. Network.framework NWListener accepts incoming HTTP connections on IPv4 loopback 127.0.0.1 (default port 47800), with acceptLocalOnly enabled. Local automation clients send JSON-RPC 2.0 requests to /rpc to inspect the open drawing, execute CAD/BIM commands and undo edits. The server is off by default; every /rpc request needs a random per-launch bearer token. It does not listen on LAN or internet interfaces. network.client supports outgoing requests and does not replace permission to accept incoming connections.

REPRODUCTION:
1. Open a drawing or the bundled Cedar House. Choose Oanarina Archi Tool > Settings... (Command-comma), select Agents, and click Start under LOCAL AGENT SERVER. Oanarina Archi Tool > Agent Server... or the in-app command AGENTS opens the same panel.
2. In Terminal run: curl http://127.0.0.1:47800/health
The app responds with JSON containing "status":"ok" and "rpc":"/rpc". This health endpoint requires no token.
3. Click Copy Token in the panel. Replace PASTE_TOKEN_HERE in this Terminal command:
curl http://127.0.0.1:47800/rpc -H 'Authorization: Bearer PASTE_TOKEN_HERE' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"run_command","params":{"command":"CIRCLE 0,0 500"}}'
The response contains a JSON-RPC result and a circle appears in the drawing. Edit > Undo reverses it. Click Stop in Agents to stop accepting connections. Use the displayed port if changed from 47800.

No external AI software, account, API key or cloud service is needed to test this incoming server functionality.

sandboxUsageInformation.com.apple.security.network.server: Required by the built-in opt-in local agent server. Network.framework NWListener accepts incoming HTTP connections only on 127.0.0.1:47800 (configurable port), with acceptLocalOnly enabled, and responds to JSON-RPC 2.0 at /rpc. Local automation tools inspect the open drawing, run CAD/BIM commands and undo edits, visible live in the app. Off by default; every RPC request requires a random per-launch bearer token. No LAN/internet listener. To test: open a drawing, choose Oanarina Archi Tool > Settings > Agents > Start, then run curl http://127.0.0.1:47800/health in Terminal. The app responds with status ok. Copy Token in the same panel to exercise the authenticated CIRCLE command documented in App Review Notes; Undo reverses it. Stop ends incoming connections. No AI account or external service is required.
